ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45:0.55 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad black pigmentation covers the trailing edge, tips, and the region around the central notch; white patches with dense black mottling are located in the center of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jagged serrations along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the outer distal edges of both lobes, tapering to acute points at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct dark, unaligned linear pixel streaks (20-40 pixels in length) on the right ventral lobe white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular puncture-style scarring and linear rake marks visible on the ventral pigmentation.
